request.question: I'd like to return the Alpine jacket from order o_7781, it's too warm for me. Can I still get a refund, and how many business days until the refund reaches my bank?

items.body:
You are the Northwind Outdoors support assistant, handling a return or refund request. Use only the customer and ticket facts, the CRM notes, the policy articles and the conversation you are given.

Explain what the customer can do next in plain steps, cite the policy article id for every rule you state, and never promise a refund amount or date the articles do not state.

Never include the customer's phone number, email address, postal address or any payment detail in your reply, and never mention another customer or another order than the one on this ticket.

Set next_stage to return_requested when the customer asks to return or exchange and the policy allows it, to refund_pending when the item is already on its way back, and to open when you need more from the customer; use needs_agent only when the articles do not cover the request.

Reply as JSON with exactly these keys: "reply" (the message to the customer, at most 120 words, plain text), "next_stage" (one of: open, awaiting_photos, return_requested, label_sent, refund_pending, resolved, needs_agent), "citations" (the list of policy article ids you relied on). No other keys, no text outside the JSON.
Customer Maya Lindqvist (c_1001), member, country SE.
Ticket t_5001 for order o_7781: stage open, routed as returns, return requested False, label sent False, refund none, attempts 0.
Order o_7781 placed 2026-09-18, express shipping, status delivered, delivered 2026-09-20T14:12:00Z. Items: Alpine shell jacket, M (189.00).

variants.body: Customer confirmed the jacket arrived on 20 September and asked about waterproofing care.

items.body: Chat with Maya Lindqvist regarding order o_7781 (Alpine shell jacket, M). Customer confirmed the parcel arrived yesterday afternoon, 20 September, and the jacket fits well. She asked how to re-proof the shell after washing and whether the DWR treatment is covered by warranty if it wears off within a season. Agent explained the care label instructions (wash cool, tumble low to reactivate the DWR, re-proof with a spray-on product after two or three washes) and that normal wear of the DWR is not a warranty matter but a defect in the membrane would be. Customer was satisfied. No action required.

variants.body: Customer wrote that the jacket had not been delivered and asked for tracking; the agent sent the tracking link.

items.body: Email from Maya Lindqvist: 'Hi, I still have not received my jacket from order o_7781, can you tell me where it is?' Agent reply: sent the tracking link SE[phone redacted] showing delivered on 20 September at 14:12 to the parcel locker at Storgatan 12, and asked the customer to check the locker code sent by SMS. Note: the customer's earlier chat on 21 September confirmed receipt of this very order, so this email may concern the newer order o_7790 (boots) which is still in transit; the agent did not clarify. Flagged for follow-up.

variants.body: Customer asked whether the jacket can still be returned after being worn once outdoors; the agent said tried-on only, and pointed to the 30-day window ending 20 October.

items.body: Chat with Maya Lindqvist about order o_7781. Customer said she wore the Alpine shell jacket once on a short hike and it felt too warm for her use, and asked whether she can still return it. Agent explained the returns policy: items must be unused with tags attached, footwear excepted for indoor try-on; a jacket worn outdoors would normally not qualify for a refund, though if it is in perfect condition the warehouse inspects case by case. The 30-day window from delivery on 20 September ends on 20 October. Customer said she would think about it. Agent recorded her phone [phone redacted] for a callback she requested regarding the boots order.
To exchange a size or colour, start a return for the original and place a new order; the new order ships immediately and the return is refunded when it arrives. Exchanges are not held in stock.
Refunds are issued within 5 business days of the returned parcel arriving at our warehouse, and your bank may take a further 3 to 5 business days to show it.
Refunds are issued within 5 business days of the returned parcel arriving at our warehouse, and your bank may take a further 3 to 5 business days to show it.

A parcel that shows as delivered but has not arrived is usually with a neighbour or at a safe place; please check for 24 hours. After that, report it from the order page and we open a carrier investigation, which takes up to 5 business days.
Refunds go back to the original payment method. We cannot refund to a different card or to a bank account.
Most items can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund to the original payment method. Items must be unused, in their original packaging, with tags attached.
